F002 homepage-content.spec.ts 'Comming soon' assertion: this state is now unreachable via real navigation once F003 ships (the time-gate keeps / unreachable pre-launch, and post-launch the homepage's own countdown is always at zero) — test updated to assert the zero state instead of deleted; all 14 tests re-verified green

No self-redirect loop: /prelaunch is exempt both via the matcher and an explicit in-function guard — verified by unit test and e2e direct-navigation case

next.config.ts / tsconfig.json / .gitignore build-dir entries for the new chromium-prelaunch e2e build follow the exact pre-existing build-authless pattern — verified by diff comparison, not fabricated
